summary:
GHSA-vr5j-9r89-725x: CPU amplification in the unci pixel-interleave decode
path (get_tile_data_sizes() iterated over every column of a tile). Fixed
upstream by 2f642b11, released in 1.23.6; carried here since the
v1.23.4..v1.23.6 squash (+e2) and present in the forky 1.23.6 source we
build from (unc_decoder_pixel_interleave.cc computes bits_per_row in
closed form; no Debian or Echo patch touches the file).
Refs:
  - https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/security/advisories/GHSA-vr5j-9r89-725x
  - https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/commit/2f642b11f9e2d5df189cdba86208bde4bbe08618
  - https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/TEMP-0000000-153207
